layers.names: every file of the 24 listings, by its name only; nothing opened
layers.structure: sample files opened for their headers, keys or labels (spec/raw_columns.json)
layers.archive_directories: central directories of a sample of zip archives read by byte ranges (pipeline/zip_directory.py); no archive downloaded
layers.values: values read in full from two groups of files (data/pipeline/raw_values.csv)

levels.test: tied to a test by name
levels.day_or_session: tied to a day or session by name

_meta.units: bytes as the PSI listing reports them
_meta.archive_sample: A sample: directories of 23 archives chosen by size class and name pattern (3 by size, then the median-size archive of the 20 largest name-pattern groups); member names were read, members were not opened.

quote_relation.states_meaning: the quote says what files with this name part are or hold, or what the name part denotes
quote_relation.expansion_only: the quote expands an abbreviation (a glossary or acronym entry); it does not say what files with this name part hold
quote_relation.about_another_thing: the quote is about a related thing (a file type, the PSI web record, one named file, a camera, a procedure step or a recording format), not about what files with this name part hold
quote_relation.name_form_only: the quote gives the form of the name only, not what the files hold

_meta.several_rows_and_other_ties: A file whose tie reaches several rows is counted once for each row in test_files.csv (column files_also_counted_for_another_row); summing files over rows counts such files more than once. data/pipeline/name_tie_alternatives.csv lists every file where another rule, or another match of the same rule, would tie a different set of rows; the first match in rule order decides (rule_order).

open_points.text: Folders 'Legacy/OMA Format/059_UT058_forHSV_splice_images_DSC957_data' (1,910 files) and 'Legacy/OMA Format/084_ForHSV_splice_UT083c_DSC957_data' (1,878 files) carry two day-like numbers; the first (059, 084) equals no 'Test Date' day, so the files are tied by the second (058, 083). A person decides whether to keep these ties.
'18269D1_for 18274D1_ACME.zip' carries two test days; the first (18269) decides, 18274 is not tied (name_tie_alternatives.csv).

'vlc-record-2020-12-05-01h42m50s-udp____20339_IgniterCheck' (.mp4 and .zip) ties day 20339 by rule R1; the date 2020-12-05 in the same name would tie another row by rule R3 (name_tie_alternatives.csv).

Table rows 81-88 repeat Flex Number, CIR and date of rows 24-31 and are not tests of tests.csv; files tied to rows 24-31 are also tied to rows 81-88 (files_also_counted_for_another_row of test_files.csv).

Five files whose names carry CIR 'F180D02' and the date 2017-06-29 are tied by rule C to row 38 (Flex Number 1301, CIR 'f180d02', Test Date '29-Jul-17'); the date in the same names equals the Test Date '29-Jun-17' of row 37 (Flex Number 1300) (name_tie_alternatives.csv).
Archive names carry either the 'Date on videos and images' (rule A1) or a date that is only an 'Actual Date' (rule A2); the documents do not say which date the archives are named by.

The fixed sentence 'Opened videos of this investigation show readings as on-screen text: ...' is attached to raw_state items of every variable of these investigations, also of variables that are not among the labels seen. A person decides whether to keep it.

sentences: A tie by name means that the name carries the identifier of that test (or day), equal to a cell of the experimental table; the content of the file was not checked.
Of 60866 listed files, 12934 are tied to a test by name, 30634 to a day or session, and 17298 are not tied.
219 sample files were opened for their headers, keys or labels; one file of a group does not show what the other files of the group hold.
288 files were read in full for values (raw_values.csv); no value of a raw file is used by the pipeline.
The directory of 23 of 12689 archives was read by byte ranges without downloading them (4401457 bytes fetched for 52471079132 bytes of archives); the member names are a sample.
The rank of data/pipeline/retrieval_queue.csv is a fixed ordering rule (tests lacking the value, descending, then bytes of the group, ascending); it is not a priority set by the team or by NASA.
None of these layers says that a file holds a quantity, nor whether its values are complete or calibrated.
sentences_archive_directories_all: The central directories of 12600 of the 12689 archives in the PSI listings were read by byte ranges: 2053572781 bytes fetched for 12808926048063 bytes of archives; no archive was downloaded and no member was opened.
They list 12662319 members: 11421918 still images, 1208708 camera frames (.hobj), 10668 text files and 21025 others, by the extension of the member name.
A member name and an archive name are tied to table rows by the name rules of spec/raw_names.json; a tie by name says that the name carries an identifier of the table, not what the file holds.
